notes.title: Patch 1.3.1 Release Notes: Unveiling The Dungeon's Diverse Delights
notes.notes:
🌟 Greetings, Intrepid Explorers! 🌟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44775786/b7bb40948797ed0f5e9eac7e782992cd381f191a.gif[/img]

I'm excited to present Patch 1.3.1: The Dungeon's Diverse Delights! This streamlined update is packed with new customizations and technical improvements to enhance your adventure through the dungeons.

✨ What's New: Flexible Fables: You can now switch "certain scenes" to alternative versions seamlessly—thanks to my collaboration with Vile Villain Entertainment. Simply adjust these in the game settings!

🛠️ Gameplay Enhancements: Navigational Nirvana: Enjoy smoother navigation in the full-screen gallery using your keyboard or controller. Monster Queen Scene Fixed: The final end scene of the Monster Queen now displays correctly in the gallery, allowing you to enjoy every detail of this climactic encounter.

🔧 Technical Tweaks: Sound Solutions: Fixed an issue where sounds were playing twice in certain scenes. New Exporter and API Updates: I've upgraded to a newer NW.js version to enhance overall game performance and stability. Also, the Greenworks API for achievements has been updated. Please let me know if you encounter any issues!

🐞 Bug Fixes: I've made additional minor tweaks to ensure your dungeon delving experience is as smooth and engaging as possible.

Thank you to everyone for your ongoing support and feedback. A special thanks to Vile Villain Entertainment for their contributions. Your input is invaluable and continually helps me refine and enhance the game.

Adventure awaits,  
Dualarcade

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2.1: The Dungeon’s Definitive Delight
notes.notes:
🎉 Hello, Bold Adventurer! 🎉
Prepare to delve deeper than ever before with Patch 1.2.1: The Dungeon's Definitive Delight—our grand finale of updates that's bound to seduce your senses. This is not just an update; it's the crowning jewel of our adventures, polishing every pixel to sheer perfection. Ready your wits and weapons, for this is where legends are forged.

✨ What’s New:
[list]
[*]PixPix, the Riddle Maiden: Tucked away in Level 4, PixPix awaits with a smirk and a puzzle. Solve her cunning riddle—can you unlock the secrets she guards so playfully?
[*]Gallery Glamour Enhanced: We’ve added sound to our gallery! Press 'M' on the keyboard or 'X' on the controller to bring scenes to life. For a truly immersive experience, enter fullscreen mode with 'Space' or 'Y' on your gamepad.
[/list]
🛠️ Gameplay Enhancements:
[list]
[*]Retro Controls Refined: Curious about controls? Hold 'Left Shoulder Button' or 'I' on the keyboard to reveal the key overlay, guiding your every move.
[*]Optimized for All Screens: Larger texts and refreshed key overlays ensure clarity and readability across all devices, including the Steam Deck. No squinting required here!
[*]New Achievement - 'The Quickest Shot in the West': Think you're fast? Prove it by skipping a cutscene faster than a shooting star![/list]
🎭 Major Character Reworks:
[list]
[*]Ravishingly Reworked Characters: Gloopie, Flapette, Ember, Lazure, Slithersweet, and Webbywink dazzle anew with stunning, handcrafted visuals. They're not just redrawn; they're reimagined to enchant you anew.
[*]Ectobreast's Grand Entrance: What was once a tutorial teaser is now a full-fledged foe! Ectobreast now reigns over Level 1, captivating all who dare challenge her with her own exclusive cutscene.
[*]Extra Frames for the Monster Queen's Cutscene: Enjoy a more fluid and dynamic experience with newly added frames, bringing the Monster Queen's cutscene to life like never before.[/list]

🔧 Technical Tweaks:[list]
[*]Inventory and Menu Magic: Streamlined displays enhance your interaction, making it as smooth as the potions you brew.
[*]Sold Out Sophistication: 'Adventurer's Delight' will now mark itself sold out after three purchases—because some treasures are meant to be rare.[/list]
🐞 Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Invisibility Potion Polished: No more lingering effects after leaving Level 8; what happens in the dungeon, stays in the dungeon.
[*]Controller Conundrums Cleared: Numerous improvements ensure that your journey through menus is as smooth as your dungeon crawling.
[*]Fixed Cutscene for Timbera: Enjoy a seamless narrative with the now fully operational cutscene for Timbera.
[/list]

Celebrate the climax of our shared escapades with Patch 1.2, a masterpiece of craft and cunning, beauty, and battle. This is where your mettle is tested, your courage confirmed, and your desires delighted.

Happy Delving, Adventurer! And remember—within these dungeon walls, temptation is not just a part of the treasure; it’s a promise of the pleasures to come.


A Personal Thank You:
As we release Patch 1.2: The Dungeon's Definitive Delight, I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to each of you. Your enthusiasm, bug reports, feedback, and occasional hilarious memes have been the driving force behind every update. Without your sharp eyes and wit, we might still be wondering why Ectobreast was lighting up the dungeon.

This final content patch is a labor of love, designed to enhance your adventures and challenge your skills. While this may be the last major content update, I will continue to squash bugs and ensure your experience remains smoother than Gloopie's new animation.

And this isn't the end—there's more in the works. While it will take some time to bring these projects to life, you can look forward to a spin-off game later this year and another adventure in the same universe possibly next year. Exciting times are ahead!

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your support means the world to me.
Happy delving & warm regards,
Dualarcade & Shady Corner Games

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.7 - Enhancements and Fixes
notes.notes:
We're back with more updates to ensure your journey through the dungeon is smoother and more immersive. Here’s what’s new in version 1.1.7:

[list]
[*] Gemlyn's Animation Refined: Swapped out incorrect non-shadow frames in Gemlyn's animations for the right ones. She's now as sleek and shadowy as intended!
[*] Invisibility Potion Effect Fixed: Addressed a glitch where the blur effect from an invisibility potion remained active in a Level if a player exited the level before the potion's effect expired and then returned after a restart due to dying. Effects now properly reset upon leaving a level or after a game restart.
[*] Gallery Improvements: Squashed several bugs in the gallery and enhanced controller support for easier navigation.
[*] Gallery Animation Finish: Added a finish animation to the gallery loop for a smoother viewing experience.
[*] Adventurer’s Delight Update in Shop: After purchasing Adventurer’s Delight three times, it will now correctly display as sold out, removing the price tag to avoid confusion.
[*] As always, we're grateful for your feedback and dedication. These updates are for you, the adventurers, who inspire us to continuously improve the dungeon experience.
[/list]

Happy delving!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.6:
notes.notes:
Hello, intrepid adventurers! Exciting times are upon us as we celebrate the Steam release with a bounty of updates to make your dungeon delving even more enchanting. Here's what's new and improved in version 1.1.6: 

✨ New Encounters Await: 
[list]
[*] Aiko the Dancing Kitsune twirls into our dungeon, bringing a touch of mystery and a dash of charm. Can you find her and something she lost? 
[*] 2 New Monsters have crept into the shadows. Each one is eager to test your mettle, so sharpen those swords! 
[*] Sproutella has undergone a makeover! Check out her new design and experience her in a whole new light. 
[*] Battyboo has undergone a makeover. Our beloved Battyboo flaunts a brand new design! Dive back into the depths to catch a glimpse of her updated look - it's sure to add an extra spark to your encounters. 
[/list]

🛠️ Quality of Life Improvements: 
[list]
[*] Out-of-Bound Chests No More: Those just-out-of-reach chests? They've been repositioned for your looting pleasure. 
[*] Enemy Attack Timer: A new slider now graces your journey, offering a visual cue for the enemy's next attack. Stay sharp! 
[*] Checkpoint Magic: Jump back into the heart of adventure from levels 7 or 14, and keep the action going. 
[*] Cleared some corners: Minor level fixes await. 
[*] Holding the torch does not pull enemy's from far away anymore. 
[*] Item Use Feedback: Added a distinct sound cue for when you try to use an item but find your pockets empty. It's the little things that keep you on your toes! 
[*] Shop Interactions Improved: Now, when you attempt to make a purchase without enough coins or if an item is sold out, an error sound will gently inform you of your unsuccessful attempt. Shop smarter, not harder! 
[/list]

🔧 Tweaks and Fixes: 
[list]
[*] Bug Busting: A few pesky bugs have been squished underfoot, smoothing out your path to victory. 
[*] D-pad Up Lever Fix: Addressed a sneaky bug where the D-pad up wasn't playing nice with levers. 
[*] Questgiver Conversations Streamlined: Fixed an oversight where the spell menu would pop up during heartfelt conversations with our dungeon's questgivers. Now, you can focus on their words without unexpected interruptions. 
[*] Several animation fixes.
[*] Steamdeck compatibility testing.
[*] Graphical Glitch on Level 17: We've banished an annoying graphical glitch that was haunting level 17. Explore with clarity and enjoy the scenery as it was meant to be seen! 
[*] Spelling Correction: A rogue spelling mistake has been corrected. Our adventure is not only about battling monsters but also conquering the English language.
[/list]

🏆 Steam Exclusive Achievements:
[list]
[*] Activated Steam achievements. 
[*] Revel in the glory of the "GenerousHeart" as you discover the hidden ending. Only the most dedicated adventurers will uncover what lies beneath. 
[*] "Shroom Room": Discover a hidden ecological treasure that tells tales of the dungeon's less traveled paths. 
[*] "A Nice Pair": Become the unseen force that shapes the destiny of two nice ladies of the dungeon. 
[/list]

📖 More Stories to Tell: 
[list]
[*] 4 New Story Panels for the different endings have been added, enriching the tapestry of tales waiting to be discovered. 
[*] A short video "Before the dungeon" was made that tells the story of the adventurer (Available shortly) 
[/list]

Happy delving!
